(Will get music soon).|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Mannrobics''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|2,000}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/681405668/profile RostTyme]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} MannrobicsNew.gif|Second version (9 November 2019 – 29 October 2020) Mannrobics.gif|First version (5 August 2019 – 9 November 2019) }} ==Trivia== *This taunt was based on a similar taunt of the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Mannrobics same name] in the game ''Team Fortress 2'', which in turn was based on [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TIfAkOBMf5A This Aerobic Video Wins Everything] which is a small excerpt from the National Aerobic Championship USA 1986. **The original music was an instrumental from the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L7kFlkW-qN8 National Aerobic Championship Theme]. ==Update History== *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **'''Mannrobics''' added. *'''9 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.9|BETA v1.9.0]] **Music added. **Description changed. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **Animation replaced. **Music replaced. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **You can no longer move while performing this emote. *'''22 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]e **Music removed. *'''7 June 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]]c **Music re-added. {{EmoteNavBox}}
